label: Peplink MAX Transit (LTE-A, CAT-12)
description: Transportation router with one LTE-A CAT-12 modem: 1x GE WAN (convertible), 1x GE LAN, 400 Mbps throughput, Wi-Fi.
notes: Vendor figures from the Peplink tech-spec sheet: Ethernet WAN port 1 / 0 (GE), LAN port 1 / 2 (GE), Router Throughput 400 Mbps, Wi-Fi AP Yes. Same ports and same 400 Mbps ceiling as the Transit Duo, **half the modems** - the Duo is the redundancy model, and nothing on the port side shows the difference.
